title: An unqueried coordinate
statement: Let a nonadaptive tester of Boolean strings of length $n$ make $r$ queries, and fix a seed for its randomness. If $r<n$, then some coordinate is not queried at any of the tester's $r$ transcript positions.
hypotheses_covered: The tester's domain is the set of coordinates of a Boolean string of length $n$
A seed of the tester is fixed
The number of query positions satisfies $r<n$
